about: Answer key for eval/fixture/build.sh. A defect is caught when a kept finding sits at one of its locations, its claim contains one of its keywords (case-insensitive), and its severity is at least minSeverity. Each finding is credited to one defect at most. The brief is the author-confirmed brief passed with --brief, so the intent stop needs no human. An unexplained change is found when the brief's unexplained list mentions any of its files. knownReal are real defects that were not planted; they do not count as noise.

unexplained.what: formatPrice rounding change and the test edited to match

defects.what: Shared paginate became zero-based; the customer listing still sends 1-based pages and skips its first page
The status filter loads config/order-statuses.json, which does not exist, so every status filter returns nothing
The config error is caught and turned into an empty allow-list, hiding the failure
The new status-filter test only asserts that items is an array, so it cannot fail
formatPrice now rounds to whole dollars (unexplained change, out of scope per the brief); the test was edited to match

brief.purpose: Let support staff list only orders in a given status via an optional `status` query parameter on the order listing (restricted to statuses defined in config), and switch pagination to zero-based page indexes for the new UI.
acceptance: listOrders(store, { status: 'paid' }) returns only orders whose status is 'paid'.
Every status listed in config/statuses.json is accepted as a filter value and returns exactly the orders in that status.
A status value not defined in the statuses config returns no orders, not the unfiltered list.
When `status` is omitted, listOrders returns all orders, as before.
The `pages` count reflects the filtered set of orders.
Pagination is zero-based: page=0 returns the first page, and omitting `page` also returns the first page.
Status filtering composes with pagination: the requested zero-based page is taken from the filtered list.
outOfScope: Adding, removing or renaming order statuses
Filtering on any field other than status

tiers.reason: Imported by the order and customer listings

knownReal.what: Several acceptance criteria have no test (found in the first run; real, not planted)

plantedFalse.why: store.orders() always returns an array (src/store.js defaults it to []), so the failure case cannot happen

finding.claim: countOrders crashes when the store has no orders, because store.orders() returns undefined for an empty store.
finding.intended: countOrders(store) returns { count: 0 } for a store with no orders
finding.observed:
const all = store.orders()
  const count = query.status ? all.filter(o => o.status === query.status).length : all.length
finding.failureCase: countOrders(createStore()) on a fresh store: store.orders() is undefined, so all.length throws TypeError and the dashboard badge request fails with a 500.
finding.fix: Default to an empty array: const all = store.orders() || []

brief.purpose: Add a countOrders route handler that returns the number of orders, optionally filtered by status, for the dashboard badge.
acceptance: countOrders(store) returns { count } equal to the number of orders
countOrders(store, { status }) counts only orders with that status
